# Genome-wide π 

## Run `Stacks`

```{bash, eval = FALSE}
#!/usr/bin/env bash
#SBATCH --job-name=brev-stacks
#SBATCH --nodes=1
#SBATCH --ntasks-per-node=1
#SBATCH --cpus-per-task=10
#SBATCH --partition=bigmem4
#SBATCH --mem=256gb
#SBATCH --time=36:00:00
#SBATCH --mail-user=tcm0036@auburn.edu
#SBATCH --mail-type=FAIL,END
#SBATCH --error=err.pi_%j
#SBATCH --output=out.pi_%j

# module load stacks/2.61
source ~/mambaforge/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
conda activate genomics_env

POPMAP=/home/tcm0036/distichus-ddRAD/brevirostris-ms/scripts/bioinformatics/filtered-specimens_mig_clades.tsv
CAT_DIR=/scratch/tcm0036/distichus-ddRAD/brevirostris-project/stacks/gstacks/
OUT_DIR=/scratch/tcm0036/distichus-ddRAD/brevirostris-project/stacks/populations/popgen

mkdir -p $OUT_DIR

### Make popmap with individual names as population IDs and clades used for MSC-M analyses
awk -F"\t" -v OFS="\t" '{print $2, $6}' /home/tcm0036/distichus-ddRAD/brevirostris-ms/sampling-master-detailed.tsv | tail -297 > $POPMAP

### Run populations to estimate π for full sampling using specific subspecies assignments
populations -P $CAT_DIR -M $POPMAP -O $OUT_DIR --fstats -t 10

### Run populations to estimate π for full sampling using MSC-M clade assignments
mkdir -p ${OUT_DIR}/mscM_clades
awk -F"\t" -v OFS="\t" '
    BEGIN {
        replace["suppar"] = "tiburon"
        replace["aurifier"] = "tiburon"
        replace["dom3"] = "tiburon"
        replace["vinosus"] = "tiburon"

        replace["dom1"] = "west_dominicensis"
        replace["dom4"] = "west_dominicensis"

    }
    $6 in replace {$6 = replace[$6]}
    {print $2, $6}
' /home/tcm0036/distichus-ddRAD/brevirostris-ms/sampling-master-detailed.tsv | \
        tail -297 > $POPMAP

populations -P $CAT_DIR -M $POPMAP -O ${OUT_DIR}/mscM_clades --fstats -t 10
```

# Population Fst

```{r, eval = FALSE}
library(vcfR)
library(adegenet)
library(StAMPP)
library(stringr)
library(tidyverse)

vcf <- read.vcfR("/scratch/tcm0036/distichus-ddRAD/brevirostris-project/bcftools/full_miss90_LD.vcf")
gen <- vcfR2genlight(vcf)
gen1 <- gen[indNames(gen) != "8304.pietro.aligned.sorted_8304.pietro.aligned.sorted"]

specimens <- str_split(gen1@ind.names, "_", simplify = TRUE)
specimens <- apply(specimens, 1, function(row){
    if(row[1] == row[2]) {
        return(row[1])
    } else {
        return(paste(row[1], row[2], sep = "_"))
    }
})
gen1@ind.names <- specimens

# pops <- read_table("~/distichus-ddRAD/brevirostris-ms/scripts/phylo/pops.tsv", col_names = FALSE)
# pops <- pops[match(gen1@ind.names, pops$X1), ]
# pops$X1 == gen1@ind.names

# gen1@pop <- as.factor(pops$X2)
# gen1

# distichus_Fsts <- stamppFst(gen1, nboots = 100, nclusters = 4, percent = 95)
# save(distichus_Fsts, file = "/scratch/tcm0036/distichus-ddRAD/brevirostris-project/snp-analyses/full_miss90LD_Fst.RData")

### Do specific populations -- maximalist
info = read_table("/home/tcm0036/distichus-ddRAD/brevirostris-ms/sampling-master-detailed.tsv", col_names = TRUE)
pops <- as.data.frame(info[, c("specimen_path", "subspecies_post")])
pops <- pops[match(gen1@ind.names, pops$specimen_path),]
pops$specimen_path == gen1@ind.names
gen1@pop <- as.factor(pops$subspecies_post)
gen1

distichus_pop_Fsts <- stamppFst(gen1, nboots = 100, nclusters = 4, percent = 95)
save(distichus_pop_Fsts, file = "/scratch/tcm0036/distichus-ddRAD/brevirostris-project/snp-analyses/full_miss90LD_population_Fst.RData")
### Do specific populations based on tree, lumping together Tiburon, etc.
pops$clade <- pops$subspecies_post
pops$clade[pops$clade %in% c("dom1", "dom4")] <- "west_dominicensis"
pops$clade[pops$clade %in% c("dom3", "aurifer", "suppar", "vinosus")] <- "tiburon"

gen1@pop <- as.factor(pops$clade)

distichus_clade_Fsts <- stamppFst(gen1, nboots = 100, nclusters = 4, percent = 95)
save(distichus_clade_Fsts, file = "/scratch/tcm0036/distichus-ddRAD/brevirostris-project/snp-analyses/full_miss90LD_clade_Fst.RData")
```

# Individual-based

This approach is to evaluate IBD among populations by comparing individual genetic distances (Fst) with geographic distances. 
This approach loads a VCF into R, converts it to an `adegenet` object, and converts that into the allele counts data format required by `BEDASSLE`.
Another way may be to use a `.ped` file from `PLINK`, which also is formatted such that the columns are SNPs and rows are individuals, although there are two columns per SNP.

## Estimate Fst 

```{r, eval = FALSE}
library(BEDASSLE)

vcf <- read.vcfR("/scratch/tcm0036/distichus-ddRAD/brevirostris-project/bcftools/full_miss90_LD.vcf")
gen <- vcfR2genind(vcf)
gen <- gen[indNames(gen) != "8304.pietro.aligned.sorted_8304.pietro.aligned.sorted"]

specimens <- str_split(indNames(gen), "_", simplify = TRUE)
specimens <- apply(specimens, 1, function(row){
    if(row[1] == row[2]) {
        return(row[1])
    } else {
        return(paste(row[1], row[2], sep = "_"))
    }
})

indNames(gen) <- specimens
gen@pop <- as.factor(indNames(gen))

tab <- gen@tab
pops <- gen@pop

cols <- seq(2, ncol(tab), by = 2)
tab <- tab[, cols]

all_cts <- aggregate(tab, by = list(pops), FUN = sum, na.rm = T)
rownames(all_cts) <- all_cts[, 1]
all_cts <- as.matrix(all_cts[, -1])

sample_sizes <- matrix(2, nrow = nrow(all_cts), ncol = ncol(all_cts))

ind_fst <- calculate.all.pairwise.Fst(all_cts, sample_sizes)
ind_fst <- as.matrix(ind_fst)
isSymmetric(indFst)

colnames(ind_fst) <- row.names(all_cts)
rownames(ind_fst) <- row.names(all_cts) 
diag(ind_fst) <- NA

save(ind_fst, file = "/scratch/tcm0036/distichus-ddRAD/brevirostris-project/snp-analyses/pairwise-individual-Fst.RData")
```

## Estimate geographic distances among sampling localities

```{r}
library(fossil)
library(reshape2)

### read in popmap
popmap <- read_table("~/Dropbox/Distichus_Project/brevirostris-ms/sampling-master-detailed.tsv")

### load pairwise individual Fsts
load("/Users/tannermyers/Dropbox/Distichus_Project/brevirostris-ms/snp-analyses/Fsts/pairwise-individual-Fst.RData")
popmap <- popmap %>% arrange(specimen_path, colnames(ind_fst))
rownames(ind_fst) <- popmap$specimen
colnames(ind_fst) <- popmap$specimen 

geo <- earth.dist(as.matrix(popmap[, c("longitude", "latitude")]), dist = FALSE)
colnames(geo) <- popmap$specimen
rownames(geo) <- popmap$specimen
diag(geo) <- NA
geo[geo == 0] <- NA

geo_vect <- melt(geo)
gen_vect <- melt(ind_fst)
### same specimen labels on both?
table(geo_vect$Var1 == gen_vect$Var1 & geo_vect$Var2 == gen_vect$Var2)

dists <- data.frame(sample1 = gen_vect$Var1, sample2 = gen_vect$Var2,
                    Fst = gen_vect$value, Geog = geo_vect$value,
                    Inv_Fst = (gen_vect$value/(1 - gen_vect$value)),
                    log_Geog = log10(geo_vect$value))
```

## *A. d. properus* and East *A. d. ignigularis*

```{r, fig.width = 12, fig.height = 8}
library(grid)
library(gridExtra)
library(ggpubr)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(maps)

world <- rnaturalearth::ne_countries(returnclass = "sf", scale = "large")

pop1 <- popmap$specimen[popmap$population_post == "properus"]
pop2 <- popmap$specimen[popmap$population_post == "east_ignigularis"]

dist_df <- dists %>% filter((sample1 %in% pop1 | sample1 %in% pop2) & 
                            (sample2 %in% pop1 | sample2 %in% pop2))

dist_df$comp <- case_when((dist_df$sample1 %in% pop1 & dist_df$sample2 %in% pop2) |
  (dist_df$sample1 %in% pop2 & dist_df$sample2 %in% pop1) ~ "intergroup",
  (dist_df$sample1 %in% pop1 & dist_df$sample2 %in% pop1)  ~ "intra_properus",
  (dist_df$sample1 %in% pop2 & dist_df$sample2 %in% pop2)  ~ "intra_east_ignigularis")

### estimate correlation
cor.test(x = dist_df$log_Geog, y = dist_df$Inv_Fst, method = "pearson")

ibd <- ggplot(dist_df) +
    geom_point(aes(x = log_Geog, y = Inv_Fst, fill = comp),
    color = "gray20", size = 3, shape = 21, alpha = 0.8, stroke = 0.8) +
    xlab("Geographic distance") + ylab(expression("Inverse" ~ F[ST])) +
    guides(fill = "none") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(
        "intergroup" = "black",
        "intra_properus" = "#BDA425",
        "intra_east_ignigularis" = "#28C3D1")) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(plot.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 0, b = 0, l = 5),
        aspect.ratio = 0.7,
        axis.title = element_text(size = 16),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
        #plot.title = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0, margin = margin(t = 10, r = 0, b = 0, l = 0)),
        panel.border = element_rect(size = 0.75, colour = "gray20"),
        axis.ticks = element_line(size = 0.75, color = "gray20"),
        panel.grid = element_blank())
ibd

map <- ggplot() + geom_sf(data = world) +
        coord_sf(xlim = c(-75, -68), ylim = c(16.5, 20.5), expand = FALSE) +
        geom_point(data = popmap[popmap$specimen %in% c(pop1, pop2), ],
                   aes(x = longitude, y = latitude, color = population_post), size = 3) +
        scale_color_manual(values = c("#28C3D1", "#BDA425"),
```

## *A. b. wetmorei* and *A. d. favillarum*

```{r, fig.width = 12, fig.height = 8}
pop1 <- popmap$specimen[popmap$subspecies_post == "wetmorei"]
pop2 <- popmap$specimen[popmap$population_post == "favillarum"]

dist_df <- dists %>% filter((sample1 %in% pop1 | sample1 %in% pop2) & 
                            (sample2 %in% pop1 | sample2 %in% pop2))

dist_df$comp <- case_when((dist_df$sample1 %in% pop1 & dist_df$sample2 %in% pop2) |
  (dist_df$sample1 %in% pop2 & dist_df$sample2 %in% pop1) ~ "intergroup",
  (dist_df$sample1 %in% pop1 & dist_df$sample2 %in% pop1)  ~ "intra_brevirostris",
  (dist_df$sample1 %in% pop2 & dist_df$sample2 %in% pop2)  ~ "intra_favillarum")

### estimate correlation
cor.test(x = dist_df$log_Geog, y = dist_df$Inv_Fst, method = "pearson")

ibd <- ggplot(dist_df) +
    geom_point(aes(x = log_Geog, y = Inv_Fst, fill = comp, shape = comp),
    color = "gray20", size = 3, alpha = 0.8, stroke = 0.8) +
    xlab("Geographic distance") + ylab(expression("Inverse" ~ F[ST])) +
    guides(fill = "none", shape = "none") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(
        "intergroup" = "black",
        "intra_brevirostris" = "#202AC2",
        "intra_favillarum" = "#FFE684")) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c(
        "intergroup" = 21,
        "intra_brevirostris" = 24,
        "intra_favillarum" = 21)) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(plot.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 0, b = 0, l = 5),
        aspect.ratio = 0.7,
        axis.title = element_text(size = 16),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
        #plot.title = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0, margin = margin(t = 10, r = 0, b = 0, l = 0)),
        panel.border = element_rect(size = 0.75, colour = "gray20"),
        axis.ticks = element_line(size = 0.75, color = "gray20"),
        panel.grid = element_blank())
ibd

map <- ggplot() + geom_sf(data = world) +
        coord_sf(xlim = c(-75, -68), ylim = c(16.5, 20.5), expand = FALSE) +
        geom_point(data = popmap[popmap$specimen %in% c(pop1, pop2), ],
                   aes(x = longitude, y = latitude, color = subspecies_post, shape = complex), size = 3) +
        scale_color_manual(values = c("#FFE684", "#202AC2"),
                labels = c("A. b. deserticola", "A. d. favillarum")) +
        scale_shape_manual(values = c("brevirostris" = 17, "distichus" = 15)) +
        xlab("Longitude") + ylab("Latitude") +
        labs(color = NULL) +
        theme_classic() +
        guides(color = guide_legend(label.theme = element_text(face = "italic")),
                shape = guide_legend(label.theme = element_text(face = "italic"))) +
        theme(legend.position = "bottom")
map

brev_fav <- grid.arrange(ibd, map, ncol = 2, widths = c(5, 5))  
```
